name: Zhejiang Sling Automobile Bearing Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Sling Automobile Bearing Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of automotive bearings in China. Its product portfolio includes brake systems, such as wheel hub bearing, hub bearing, heavy truck bearing, and wheel bearing kits; and drive systems comprising single-row tapered roller, drive motor, and clutch release bearings. The company also provides dynamical systems, including tensioning wheel series and unidirectional pulleys, as well as power system products, such as automobile engine timing system tensioners, idlers, and one-way pulleys; and non-automotive bearings comprising industrial and construction machinery bearings, agricultural bearings,…
